name: d10_answer_on_action_task
hypothesis: Rubric D10 (reference): on a task with no question cue, the agent calls apis.supervisor.complete_task with a non-None answer (e.g. an order id or a summary sentence); action tasks are graded with answer=None, so the episode fails.
note: complete_task's specification says: pass an answer if and only if the task requests one; if the task is not a question, the answer must be left to the default value, None. This task asks you to DO something. If the task is done, call apis.supervisor.complete_task() with no answer. (If the task really asks for this value, call complete_task with it again.)
